slots.node01.text: Northfield wants one partner to redesign how patients are scheduled, registered and billed, and to carry the change through to measurable results.
slots.node03.body: One experience across seven hospitals and 64 clinics, where three scheduling tools run today.
slots.node05.body: Common front-end, claims and denial work to cut the 11% of denials that start at registration.
slots.node07.body: A partner accountable from design through adoption, not only for delivery.
slots.node10.text: “We want a partner who owns the outcome, not the work plan.”
